findings.explanation: Ownership of your work product transfers immediately upon creation or as a work made for hire before you are paid, meaning you could lose your intellectual property if the Client fails to pay.
findings.suggested_change: Ownership of the Incorporated Technology Works shall transfer to the Client only upon receipt of full payment for the applicable deliverables.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a great week. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a minor adjustment before we sign. - Regarding the relevant clause, ownership of the work product transfers immediately upon creation before payment is received, meaning I could lose my intellectual property if payment is not made. I propose modifying this so that ownership of the work transfers to the client only upon receipt of full payment for the applicable deliverables. Thank you for your time and understanding. Best regards,
